Enumeration Type Documentation

enum fonts
 

Enumerator:
FNT_NONE  no fonts
FNT_TB  typebuffer-font
FNT_TT  tooltip-font
FNT_ICN  icon-label font
FNT_TP  text-path font
FNT_ALL  all fonts

enum parse_theme
 

Enumerator:
PT_SB  scrollbar factory
PT_TT  tooltip factory
PT_TB  typebuffer engine
PT_RB  rubber-band factory
PT_BG  background engine
PT_IC  icon-factory
PT_SH  icon-view (background data)
PT_IV  shelf (background data)
PT_ID  idle-handler (optional, hence not part of PT_ALL)
PT_IX  extension
PT_ALL  "all of the above"
